description: Hand-built multi-hop QA set for US immigration GraphRAG. 'gold_forms' are the USCIS forms a correct, complete answer must reference. Multi-hop questions require connecting forms across documents (e.g. an I-485 answer must surface I-864/I-693), which is where typed-graph retrieval is expected to beat naive vector RAG.
